english: Working rapidly in the darkness, he soon changed into the dead man's clothes.
text: changed into the dead man's clothes 说的是换上那个人的衣服，不是自己变成衣服。表达“换衣服”可说 change clothes，强调换上哪套则用 change into；这里服装的身份对后面的伪装很关键。
